fact: As of May 2019, a team of eight under the director of the Police Technique et Scientifique in Niamey enters criminal acts into SIPAO, a police database of offences, offenders' identities, criminal procedures and stolen items launched in Niger in 2012, funded by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL with EUCAP Sahel Niger; the team had recorded more than 8,000 cases and 700 new cases in the month, and EUCAP was training operators to enter data directly from their own service.
title: WAPIS-SIPAO : Un fichier de police pour le Niger
publisher: EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa (source : EUCAP Sahel Niger)
